title: Stevens groups K_x, K_{x,+} from a β-approximation sequence
body_html:
Stevens groups $K_x$, $K_{x,+}$ from a $\beta$-approximation sequence

Fix the classical-groups setup (see Classical groups setting: G = isometry of an ε-Hermitian form, p ≠ 2) and apartment data: an $E_i$-basis $\{w_{i,l}\}$ of each $V_i$ such that $\{w_{i,k}\}$ spans an anisotropic part. The maximal split torus $S$ is the diagonal in this basis, the apartment $A \cong \mathbb{R}^n$.

Approximation sequence

By [Stevens:SS, Prop 3.4], choose an approximation sequence $$\beta = \gamma_0,\ \gamma_1,\ \dots,\ \gamma_d = 0, \qquad \gamma_i \in \mathfrak{g},$$ with $-k_F(\gamma_i) < -k_F(\gamma_{i+1})$ and $\gamma_i \equiv \gamma_{i+1} \pmod{\mathfrak{g}_{x, -k_F(\gamma_i)}}$.

Let $s_i := -k_F(\gamma_i) / 2$ for $i = 1, \dots, d-1$ and $s_d := \mathrm{depth}_x(\beta)$. Set $G^{(i)} := G^{\gamma_i}$ (so $G^{(d)} = G$).

Definition

$$K_x \;:=\; G^{(0)}_x\, G^{(1)}_{s_1}\, \cdots\, G^{(d)}_{s_d}, \qquad K_{x,+} \;:=\; G^{(0)}_{x, 0+}\, G^{(1)}_{s_1+}\, \cdots\, G^{(d)}_{s_d+},$$ $$\hat K_x \;:=\; \hat G^{(0)}_x\, G^{(1)}_{s_1}\, \cdots\, G^{(d)}_{s_d}.$$

For $x$ a rational point in $A$, there is $e \in \mathbb{Z}_{>0}$ with $\mathrm{Jump}(\Lambda_x) \subseteq \tfrac{1}{e}\mathbb{Z}$, and the Stevens identifications $$K_x = J^\circ(\beta, \Lambda_x), \qquad K_{x,+} = H^1(\beta, \Lambda_x)$$ agree with [Stevens:SS §3.1, p.138].

Character $\phi_x$

$$\phi_x \;:=\; \Phi(V, \varphi, \Lambda'_x, 0),$$ in the notation of [KSS Def 9.4], where $\varphi$ is the natural embedding $F[\beta] \hookrightarrow \mathfrak{gl}(V)$ and $x'$ is any rational point in the same facet as $x$.

The data $(K_x, K_{x,+}, \phi_x)$ provides the $\mathscr{K}$-cosheaf used in [[node:applications.classical_K1_K2_K3]] and [[node:applications.classical_T_axioms]].
